svg.title: The path of one application
svg.desc: A submitted application goes to the decider of the first step, for many types the class teacher first. At each step it can be approved, rejected or kept under consideration. When the last step is approved, work such as leave, a waiver or a section change happens by itself. Before the decision the applicant can withdraw it. Approved leave can be cancelled later.
